Yes!
...HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

—Hmm. With our current routine, this is the limit.
In which case... improving my form would indeed be the optimal course of action.

Indeed, this is our turning point...
And at present, other methods lack a decisive edge.

Ikuno Dictus's eyes told the story.
These words came straight from her heart. I had no means... to overturn them.

.
...Is something the matter?

One summer day. I had arranged a meeting with Ikuno Dictus.
My previous meeting ran late, and as I entered the Trainer's office—

The notebook slipped from Ikuno Dictus's hands.
It slid right over to my feet, and as I picked it up—
, I take pride in having chosen the optimal approach.

Yes, I am planning to go on a long ride for the first time in a while.
I have just decided on my destination.

I have mapped out the mountain pass gradient, leaving only the tuning.
After making a few test runs up nearby slopes—

Understood, please leave the inventory check and stock reconciliation to me.
Chairwoman, please continue delegating tasks.
Yes. Thank you for your understanding.

Hmm... Trainer.
Now is the time to pour all our efforts into what must be done.

I agreed. But if we failed, her autumn race would be in jeopardy.
I explained that if we were to tackle this, now was the only window of opportunity.

The road to the goal we set is steep,
and my duties on the General Affairs Committee must not be neglected either.

However, please do not worry.
I have revised my schedule so that I can balance it with training.

We have our answer.
Let us proceed with improving my form.
Very well. This is our chance to show what we can do.

Understood.
Then let us review tomorrow's schedule——
...The long ride will have to wait for another opportunity.

Ah, you mean that?
General Affairs Committee duties have been more hectic than in past years.

That would not be a long ride.
Losing sight of that would lead me to stray from the true path.

No, please do not worry about it.
Thanks to that, I had the leeway to plan out my day off.

Proceeding as we usually do would overlap with the training camp.
A complete overhaul of the schedule is essential, so—

Its slogan is 'An observation deck every cyclist should visit at least once.'
I hear the view of the town on a clear day is truly magnificent.

...Oops, I have digressed too much. My apologies.
Shall we get down to business?

Our efforts to cut down her time began the following day.
First, by checking her current form.
—Ah.

Even though I understood, the joyful expression she had while talking about
her long ride remained stuck in my head for quite some time...

Not on purpose, but the open page caught my eye by chance.
There, crossed out, was a scheduled plan...

(With autumn as our deadline, there is no time to spare.
Starting tonight, I must gather reference materials on form—)

The meeting's topic was cutting down her race times.
We had set the target clock time to hit before autumn. All that remained was the process, but—

—That concludes today's review.
Were there any other points of concern?

Oh, from the General Affairs Chairwoman?
Yes... I see. Replacing the summer camp supplies... Understood.
